title: Phenomenological constraints on entropy-flow modifications to expansion and growth from BOSS DR12
description: The paper introduces a single-parameter phenomenological extension to ΛCDM motivated by Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), where an entropy-gradient coupling α_{L2} jointly modifies background distances, H(z), and linear growth fσ8(z). Using the BOSS DR12 consensus BAO+RSD measurements with the full 9×9 covariance, it constrains α_{L2} and finds a mild (1.7σ) preference for α_{L2}>0, alongside a characteristic anti-correlation between expansion and growth. The work highlights a sharp, falsifiable prediction η≡Φ/Ψ=1 for linear scales and frames BAO–RSD sign differences as a recasting of the S8 tension in EFC parameter space.

FLRW_E_z.description: ΛCDM dimensionless Hubble rate for a spatially flat background.

Omega_m_of_z.description: Redshift-dependent matter fraction used in the coupling functions.

DM_modification.description: Phenomenological modification of comoving distance induced by the entropy-flow coupling.

H_modification.description: Phenomenological modification of the Hubble parameter with the same single coupling α_{L2}.

growth_modification.description: Linked modification to linear growth; anti-correlated in sign with the distance modification for z>0.

gD.description: Distance-coupling function that vanishes at z=0 and at high z, peaking near the DE-dominated era.

gH.description: Hubble-rate coupling chosen for approximate consistency with the DM–H integral relation.

g_growth.description: Growth-rate coupling; negative for z>0, implying suppression of growth when distances increase.

gravitational_slip.description: EFC prediction of no gravitational slip on linear scales, contrasting with many modified-gravity models.

key_results.main_finding: BOSS DR12 yields a mild preference for α_{L2}>0 with α_{L2}=0.35±0.16 and Δχ²=3.01 (1.7σ), indicating anti-correlated changes to expansion and growth consistent with the EFC phenomenology.
datasets_used: BOSS DR12 consensus BAO+RSD (Alam et al. 2017), z = 0.38, 0.51, 0.61, full 9×9 covariance

sealed_predictions.statement: No gravitational slip on linear scales: η(z,k) = Φ/Ψ = 1 for 0.2 ≲ z ≲ 1 and k ≲ 0.1 h/Mpc.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Joint weak-lensing (Φ+Ψ) and RSD/galaxy-clustering (Ψ) analyses from Euclid and Rubin/LSST; a ≥3σ detection of η≠1 would falsify this prediction.

sealed_predictions.statement: Built-in anti-correlation between distance and growth modifications: g_D(z) > 0 while g_growth(z) < 0 for z>0.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Stage IV BAO+RSD tomography; a robust (>3σ) requirement for same-sign distance and growth deviations from ΛCDM across multiple redshift bins would rule out the model’s coupling structure.

sealed_predictions.statement: Redshift dependence peaks in the DE-dominated era (z≈0.5–0.7), with couplings vanishing at z=0 and at high z.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Tomographic BAO+RSD and lensing measurements; significant deviations from the predicted redshift profile (e.g., peak at z≪0.3 or no decay at high z) at >3σ would contradict the ansatz.

kill_criteria: KC1: A ≥3σ detection of gravitational slip η≠1 on linear scales (k<0.1 h/Mpc) over 0.2<z<1 from joint WL+RSD would falsify the EFC prediction η=1.

KC2: Stage IV joint BAO+RSD analyses that robustly (>3σ) require positively correlated deviations in distances and growth (i.e., enhanced fσ8 when D_M is increased) across multiple redshift bins, violating the model’s predicted anti-correlation (g_D>0, g_growth<0 for z>0).

KC3: High-precision tomographic constraints yielding |α_{L2}| < 0.02 (95% CL) from combined distances and growth over 0<z<1 would rule out phenomenologically relevant entropy-flow effects at the L2 scale.

KC4: A consistent (>3σ) preference for α_{L2}<0 with |α_{L2}|>0.1 together with no observed suppression of growth relative to ΛCDM across 0.3<z<0.8 would contradict the EFC-motivated interpretation aimed at alleviating the S8 discrepancy.
abstract: Single-parameter phenomenological extension of ΛCDM motivated by EFC, where entropy-gradient couplings at structure-formation scale modify both background expansion and linear growth rate. Best-fit α_L2 = 0.35 ± 0.16 with Δχ² = 3.01 (1.7σ preference). BAO-RSD sign conflict reflects S8 tension in EFC parameter space.

bao_rsd_tension.interpretation: S8 tension recast in EFC parameter space

ledger_impact.holistic_analysis: This paper establishes the first direct empirical contact between the EFC framework and large-scale structure data by constraining the phenomenological entropy-flow coupling α_{L2} against BOSS DR12 BAO+RSD measurements. It demonstrates a mild (1.7σ) preference for α_{L2}>0, consistent with the EFC-predicted anti-correlation between distance enhancement and growth suppression, and formally recasts the S8 tension into EFC parameter space. While not a decisive detection, it provides the quantitative scaffold — coupling functions g(z), likelihood infrastructure, and sealed kill criteria — upon which Stage IV tests (DESI, Euclid) will deliver verdicts.
graph_insights: This paper is currently an isolated node in the graph (no 1-2 hop connections found), which means it should be connected to: the fσ8(z=0.7)=0.430 sealed prediction node, the S8 tension observable node, the BOSS DR12 dataset node, and the planned DESI DR2 pipeline node. These edges encode the scaffolding relationship.
The BAO and RSD observable nodes touched by this paper are shared with future DESI and Euclid validation tests, making this paper a critical bridge node between current and Stage IV test clusters.

The comoving distance and Hubble parameter observables connect this paper to Type Ia supernova tests (DM(z)) and CMB-derived H0 constraints, suggesting cross-validation opportunities not explicitly mentioned in the paper.

The growth rate (fσ8) observable links directly to the 91 survived active tests — any update to the coupling function g_growth(z) from DESI data will propagate constraints through this node to multiple existing tests.

tests_added.name: BOSS DR12 BAO+RSD α_{L2} constraint
tests_added.description: Joint fit of {H0, Ωm, σ8, α_{L2}} to BOSS DR12 consensus DM, H, fσ8 at z_eff=0.38, 0.51, 0.61 using the full 9×9 covariance. Tests whether data prefer non-zero entropy-flow coupling.
tests_added.prediction: EFC predicts α_{L2}>0 with anti-correlated distance/growth modifications; found α_{L2}=0.35±0.16, Δχ²=3.01 (1.7σ), consistent but not decisive.

tests_added.name: Distance-growth anti-correlation sign test
tests_added.description: Checks that BAO-preferred α_{L2} sign (positive, g_D>0) is opposite in its growth effect (g_growth<0), as EFC requires. Decomposition into BAO-only vs RSD-only likelihoods tests this.
tests_added.prediction: EFC predicts g_D>0 and g_growth<0 for z>0; BAO prefers α_{L2}>0 while RSD weakly prefers α_{L2}<0, confirming the predicted sign structure.

tests_added.name: Gravitational slip η=1 sealed prediction (BOSS baseline)
tests_added.description: EFC predicts no gravitational slip (η=Φ/Ψ=1) on linear scales. This is identified as a sharp discriminator versus modified gravity. Not yet testable at BOSS precision; sealed for Stage IV.

tests_added.name: ΛCDM nested recovery check
tests_added.description: Verifies that α_{L2}=0 (ΛCDM) is contained within the 2σ contour, confirming the model is a proper extension rather than contradicting existing concordance.
tests_added.prediction: ΛCDM must be recoverable as α_{L2}→0; confirmed (0 lies within 2σ).

tests_added.name: Stage IV α_{L2} precision kill test
tests_added.description: If combined Stage IV BAO+RSD yields |α_{L2}|<0.02 at 95% CL, EFC phenomenological effects at L2 scale are ruled out. Paper's KC3.
tests_added.prediction: EFC expects α_{L2}~0.2-0.5 detectable at Stage IV precision.

implicit_consequences: The BOSS DR12 likelihood infrastructure (coupling functions, covariance handling, MCMC pipeline) is now directly reusable for DESI DR2 rapid-response — the biggest identified gap is partially addressed at the methodology level even though no DESI-specific script is assembled.

The sign conflict between BAO-preferred and RSD-preferred α_{L2} formally recasts the S8 tension into EFC parameter space, meaning EFC has a built-in mechanism to address S8 rather than treating it as an anomaly — this strengthens the theoretical motivation ahead of Stage IV data.

The sealed prediction η=1 (no gravitational slip) creates a clean separation between EFC and modified-gravity alternatives (f(R), DGP, etc.) that will be testable with Euclid and LSST WL+RSD cross-correlations, adding a new discriminating axis not present in the previous test battery.

The phenomenological coupling functions g_D(z) and g_growth(z) peaking at z~0.5-0.7 in the DE-dominated era align with the existing sealed prediction fσ8(z=0.7)=0.430, providing internal consistency between the sealed value and the z-dependent structure now constrained.

The paper implicitly establishes that the EFCLASS Boltzmann solver (theory-efclass-boltzmann-solver gap) is NOT required for the phenomenological layer — the coupling functions can be tested without solving the full EFC field equations, decoupling the empirical validation timeline from the theory gap timeline.

KC3 of this paper (|α_{L2}|<0.02 at 95% CL ruling out L2-scale effects) sets a quantitative falsification threshold that DESI+Euclid combined will reach, meaning KC5 monitoring should incorporate α_{L2} precision forecasts.
ledger_impact.bottom_line_change: The biggest gap remains the DESI DR2 full-shape RSD rapid-response pipeline, but it is now partially scaffolded: the BOSS DR12 paper provides the coupling functions, likelihood code, and covariance handling that form the template. The gap description should be updated to reflect that methodology exists and only the DESI-specific data interface and verification script remain.
